title.en: Photosensitive seizures provoked while viewing "pocket monsters," a made-for-television animation program in Japan
title.zh: 观看日本电视动画《精灵宝可梦》时诱发的光敏性发作

pubmed.authors: S Ishida, Y Yamashita, T Matsuishi, M Ohshima, H Ohshima, H Kato, H Maeda

text.en: Four cases were examined after viewers experienced seizures during the same televised cartoon episode.
text.zh: 研究记录了四名观看同一集电视动画时出现发作的患者。

text.en: The researchers assessed clinical histories, EEG responses and the programme's visual presentation.
text.zh: 研究者评估了临床病史、脑电图反应及节目的视觉呈现。

text.en: Two patients received different epilepsy diagnoses. For the other two, a first seizure did not establish epilepsy. Responses to testing varied; rapid colour changes were implicated in the incident.
text.zh: 两名患者被诊断为不同类型的癫痫；另两名仅凭首次发作尚不能确诊。检测反应存在差异，事件被认为与快速色彩变化有关。

text.en: The authors called for children's television production safeguards and more consistent photosensitivity testing.
text.zh: 作者呼吁规范儿童电视制作，并使光敏性检测更为一致。

title.en: Prohibiting the marketing and use of the “Mosquito” youth dispersal device
title.zh: 禁止销售及使用“Mosquito”青少年驱散装置

text.en: The Assembly considered a device that drives young people away with high-frequency sound. Its effects raised concerns about discrimination and children's health.
text.zh: 大会审议了一种利用高频声音驱散年轻人的装置，关注其涉及的歧视与儿童健康问题。

text.en: Many younger listeners find the sound distressing or painful, while older adults may not notice it. Young people are displaced regardless of their conduct.
text.zh: 许多年轻听者感到烦扰甚至疼痛，年长者却可能察觉不到。年轻人无论行为如何，都可能被迫离开。

text.en: The text reported no established hearing-loss risk at that time, but identified unanswered health questions and sought further testing and precaution.
text.zh: 文件称当时研究未显示听力损失风险，但其他健康问题仍未明确，因而要求进一步检测并采取预防措施。

text.en: It urged restrictions on these devices and better youth facilities. This recommendation was an appeal for action, rather than an enacted Europe-wide ban.
text.zh: 文件建议限制此类装置，并改善青年活动设施。这是要求采取行动的建议，并非已生效的全欧洲禁令。
